def validate_items(items):
    if not items or any(item <= 0 for item in items):
        raise ValueError("Items must be non-empty and non-negative")

def calculate_pricing(items, discount=0):
    subtotal = sum(items)
    discounted_total = subtotal * (1 - discount)
    tax_rate = 0.08  # Assuming a fixed tax rate of 8%
    total = discounted_total * (1 + tax_rate)
    return {'subtotal': subtotal, 'total': total}

def format_receipt(items, pricing_info):
    receipt = "Receipt:\n"
    receipt += "Items:\n"
    for item in items:
        receipt += f"  - {item}\n"
    receipt += f"Subtotal: ${pricing_info['subtotal']:.2f}\n"
    receipt += f"Discount: {0:.2f}\n"  # Assuming no discount applied in this example
    receipt += f"Tax (8%): ${pricing_info['total'] - pricing_info['subtotal']:.2f}\n"
    receipt += f"Total: ${pricing_info['total']:.2f}\n"
    return receipt

def process_order(items, discount=0):
    validate_items(items)
    pricing_info = calculate_pricing(items, discount)
    receipt = format_receipt(items, pricing_info)
    return receipt
